property_summary: For any admissible input, if transfer does not revert then it must return true; the buggy version violates this by returning false.
If any transferFrom call fails, the whole transaction must revert.
If any internal call to the external token fails, the entire transfer function must revert.
If any single sub-transfer fails, the whole transaction must revert rather than returning false.
If transfer does not revert, then all transfers must have succeeded, which is broken because M silently returns false on failure instead of reverting.
